processing_note: Such fees shall be payable in the manner and terms set forth in the Plan.

contract.document_name.rationale: The document is headed DISTRIBUTION AND SERVICES AGREEMENT.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: The agreement is dated January 18, 2020 in its heading and in the 'Dated:' line at execution; 1/21/2020 is the SEC filing date and January 18, 2022 is the end of the initial term.

contract.effective_date.rationale: No separate effective or commencement date is stated.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: Section 7.1: the Agreement shall continue until January 18, 2022, then renews annually.

contract.governing_law.rationale: Section 8.3 applies the laws of the State of Kansas; Delaware and North Dakota appear as organisation state and office location.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: After the initial term the agreement continues automatically for successive annual periods; other durations are notice/cure periods or reporting frequencies.

contract.notice_period.rationale: Continuance depends on annual board approval; the 60/90-day notices are for termination at any time, not a notice to prevent renewal.
